build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon and letter index map
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models for consuming consecutive word pieces
compose_decomposition_graph: compose a word graph with a lexicon graph and project output to get decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute an alignment graph by composing token and decomposition graphs then projecting input
compute_sequence_loss: compute sequence level loss by subtracting forward scores of intersected emissions and alignment graphs
